question_cn: E 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
question_en: Which team finishes first in Group E?
one_liner_cn: 德国与厄瓜多尔基本五五开（Elo 仅差 6 分），但厄瓜多尔进攻乏力在净胜球比拼上吃亏，德国以约 49.7% 对 46.1% 微弱领先。
one_liner_en: Germany and Ecuador are essentially a coin flip (6 Elo points apart), but Ecuador's anemic attack is a goal-difference-tiebreak liability, giving Germany a slim 49.7% vs 46.1% edge.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 几乎持平：厄瓜多尔 1938（世界第 9）vs 德国 1932（世界第 10），100k 次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛给出 49.6% 对 46.7% 的接近五五开基线。
key_reasons.en: Near-identical Elo: Ecuador 1938 (#9) vs Germany 1932 (#10); the 100k pure-Elo Monte Carlo baseline is a 49.6% vs 46.7% near coin flip.

key_reasons.cn: 厄瓜多尔防守极强但进攻乏力：预选赛 18 场仅进 14 球、8 场平局全部 0-0（失 5 球为南美最少）——小组头名常由净胜球决定，此画像对其不利。
key_reasons.en: Ecuador's elite-defense/anemic-attack profile: only 14 goals in 18 qualifiers and all eight draws finished 0-0 (5 conceded, best in CONMEBOL) — a liability when first place hinges on goal difference.

key_reasons.cn: 德国阵容基本齐整：Musiala 已从 2025 年 7 月腿部骨折中恢复，Neuer 小腿伤预计赶上 6-14 揭幕战，仅余轻微节奏/健康问号。
key_reasons.en: Germany's squad is essentially intact: Musiala has recovered from his July 2025 broken leg and Neuer is expected fit for the June 14 opener, leaving only mild rhythm/fitness question marks.

method_note: Baseline: 100k-sim pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, lambda = 2.6 x Elo expectancy, no market input). Bounded evidence adjustment within ±4pp/team: Germany +3.0pp, Ecuador -3.5pp, Ivory Coast +0.5pp for Ecuador's low-scoring style (goal-difference tiebreak liability) partially offset by Germany's mild fitness questions; renormalized to sum 1.
